profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Enel X
profile.summary:
I am a computer scientist with a passion for software development, all the way from initial project design through release. I enjoy working on projects involving big data, machine learning, natural language processing, and security. I wish more companies used highly available micro-service architectures and were less reliant on monolithic single point of failure legacy systems.

Please feel free to check out some of my code at: https://github.com/chprice
